# Digiit

> Digiit (by FundiT Finance Limited) provides salary-backed loans for employees of partner organisations in Nigeria, repaid through payroll deduction, at zero cost and zero risk to the employer. No collateral, no paperwork.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.digiit.com.ng/): Overview of salary-backed loans for employees and employers
- [About](https://www.digiit.com.ng/about): Company, mission and leadership
- [Apply](https://www.digiit.com.ng/apply): Employee loan application and employer partnership registration
- [Contact](https://www.digiit.com.ng/contact): Partnerships, demos and support (Victoria Island, Lagos)
- [Blog](https://www.digiit.com.ng/blog): Articles on workplace financial wellness, HR and NDPR compliance
